user.title: Energomera meter (BLE)
user.description: Select your meter by its serial number (printed on the case and in the meter's passport) and enter the PIN — the 6-digit "BLE radio interface password" from the passport. The CE901 display unit shows it as well.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Found meter {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Enter the PIN — the 6-digit "BLE radio interface password" from the meter's passport. The CE901 display unit shows it as well.

reauth_confirm.title: The meter rejected the PIN
reauth_confirm.description: Meter {name} no longer accepts the stored PIN — the BLE password was probably changed. Enter the current PIN.

reconfigure.title: Change PIN
reconfigure.description: New PIN for meter {name}. The meter will be paired again.

error.invalid_pin: The meter rejected the PIN. Check the BLE password in the passport.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed (weak signal or the meter is busy). Please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read data from the meter. Please try again — the signal is weak.

abort.no_devices_found: No CE208/CE308 meters found over Bluetooth.
abort.already_in_progress: This meter is already being set up.
abort.reauth_successful: PIN updated, the meter is being polled again.
